A Sybil tax stops fake crowds. You pay once and you can't get it back.

You pay 80 units into an oasis fund that only honest work unlocks. Each clean epoch returns 12 units as fee credit and grows your atlas of good behavior. Cheat once and the rest burns, plus you sit out 8 epochs.

Count it: 1,000 fake identities cost 80,000 units up front. If 30% get caught, 24,000 units burn in the grove of seized deposits. Honest users earn it back.
